briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 launch intensifies multi-frontier AGI competition with new safety gaps exposed

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race has entered a high-stakes phase with frontier labs releasing models at record pace amid escalating compute demands. Funding surges continue while regulatory scrutiny mounts over emerging risks.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with advanced reasoning; Anthropic countered with Claude 4 Opus; Google DeepMind previewed Gemini 3; Meta open-sourced Llama 4 400B; xAI deployed Grok-3; DeepSeek launched R2. Model proliferation signals accelerated capability gains.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, IoT and BCI applications.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits 500k units shipped; Microsoft expands Stargate supercluster; Google TPU v6 pods online; TSMC reports AI chip shortages persisting into Q4 2026.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will safety protocols scale faster than raw capability gains to prevent uncontrolled AGI emergence by 2028?
